diagnosis.hypothesis: Observed initial public validation failures only on web1-related IPv4 paths (user1<->web1, guest1<->web1, external1<->web1) while app1-related paths already passed. Read fw-ext and found firewall zone DMZ bound only to eth3 even though topology/interface addressing shows web1 subnet 10.10.40.0/24 is on eth2 and app1 subnet 10.10.50.0/24 is on eth3. Added eth2 to firewall zone DMZ on fw-ext. Re-ran public success criteria and all lab connectivity checks passed.
diagnosis.reference: On the firewall fw-ext, interface eth2 was removed from zone DMZ, so traffic from DMZ to OUTSIDE is no longer matched by ruleset DMZ-TO-OUTSIDE and is dropped.

arguments.name: DMZ
arguments.reason: Validation shows all paths to web1 (10.10.40.10) fail while app1 paths succeed. fw-ext DMZ zone is bound only to eth3, but topology and interface IPs show web1 subnet 10.10.40.0/24 is on eth2 and app1 subnet 10.10.50.0/24 is on eth3; this misbind explains web1-specific failures without broad policy changes.

action.command: set firewall zone DMZ interface eth2
